n: Galiano 36-Inch Freestanding Gas Range, , 6 Burners, Energy Efficient
desc: The Forno Galiano 36" Gas Range combines professional-grade performance with sleek stainless steel durability. The cooktop features 6 sealed burners with a total output of 83,000 BTU, including a 20,000 BTU dual-ring burner that can simmer at 1,000 BTU.
hl: The all-stainless steel finish, paired with a pro-style handle and zinc-coated metal knobs featuring decorative bezel rings, offers a sleek, professional look.
Six sealed burners deliver 83,000 BTU total output, providing versatile cooking power for any culinary task.
Burners range from 9,000 to 20,000 BTU, perfect for simmering delicate sauces or searing steaks.
A 20,000 BTU dual-ring burner offers powerful heat for searing and a gentle 1,000 BTU for simmering.
Continuous cast iron grates provide stability and ensure smooth cookware movement across the surface.
Deep recessed black enamel cooktop traps spills, making cleanup effortless.
